title: Help
scRunStatement: Run statement at cursor (selection if any)
gridInlineEdit: Click a cell to open the row editor (Enter saves, NULL vs empty string are distinct); amber placeholder rows from "Add row" fill by double-click
gridContextMenu: Right-click a cell: copy (value / JSON / row / INSERT), quick filters, delete row
gridFkJump: The pill button on linked columns jumps to the parent row — walk the relationship graph
gridChangeset: The "N changes pending" bar: review every SQL, apply all as one transaction with full rollback on failure
gridNewRow: "Add row" in the pager: fill the amber placeholder inline, right-click to stage the INSERT
skinsHint: Settings → theme cards: Border Collie black/white, Puppy orange, Sakura, Nord, Dracula, Terminal green and more (9 total)
eggDog: A Border Collie named Luna sits at the bottom of the sidebar — pet her plenty, something nice happens
